seoTitle: How to Buy a Hostinger Domain with Coupon Discounts
metaDescription: Search, register, and save on a Hostinger domain by applying coupon codes at checkout for the lowest possible price on your new website address.
intro: Registering a domain doesn't have to cost full price if you know where the discounts actually apply — first-year pricing on domains varies wildly by extension, and a coupon on top of that can push a .com down to a few dollars. This guide walks through searching for a name on Hostinger, comparing what's available across extensions, and getting through checkout with a coupon applied so you're not paying the sticker price.

steps.heading: Search for your domain name
steps.body: Hostinger's homepage puts a domain search bar front and center — type in the name you want and hit Search. The page also advertises a free domain for a year bundled with hosting, which is worth noting if you're setting up a new site from scratch rather than just registering a domain on its own.

image.caption: Hostinger's homepage search bar, where typing a name kicks off the domain availability check.

steps.heading: Compare extensions and first-year pricing
steps.body: Results come back as a list of available names across different extensions, each with its own discounted first-year rate and a Buy now button — a .tech extension at $6.99 for the first year next to a much pricier .ai at $89.99 is typical of how much the extension alone affects cost. Scroll through the tabs for Popular, Business, Technology, and other categories if your first choice is taken or overpriced; a slightly different extension can save a significant amount without hurting your brand much.

image.caption: Domain search results showing multiple extensions with their first-year discounted prices side by side.

steps.heading: Add your chosen domain to checkout
steps.body: Once you've picked a name and extension, click Buy now (or Make it yours on the featured options higher up the page) to add it to your cart. Hostinger will typically prompt you toward add-ons like domain privacy protection at this point — privacy protection is worth keeping since it hides your personal registration details from public WHOIS lookups.

steps.heading: Enter a coupon code before paying
steps.body: On the checkout page, look for a "Have a coupon code?" link near the order summary — this is separate from whatever discount is already applied to the sticker price, so a valid promo code can stack on top of it for extra savings. Paste the code in, apply it, and confirm the total updates before moving on to payment.

steps.heading: Review the order summary and choose a payment method
steps.body: The right-hand panel breaks the charge down clearly: domain registration for the first year, a small ICANN fee that's standard across all registrars, optional privacy protection, and tax, all rolled into one total. Checkout supports several payment options beyond a card — PayPal, Google Pay, Apple Pay, and regional options like AliPay — so pick whichever is fastest for you.

image.caption: Checkout with the order summary — registration fee, ICANN fee, tax, and total — alongside PayPal, Google Pay, and Apple Pay options.

steps.heading: Submit payment and verify your email
steps.body: Complete the payment, and Hostinger will send a confirmation email to the address on your account — verifying that email is typically required before the domain is fully active and usable. Once verified, the domain shows up in your Hostinger dashboard under Domains, ready to be pointed at a hosting plan or an external platform like Shopify or WordPress.

faq.question: Where do I enter a coupon code when buying a domain?
faq.answer: Coupon codes are typically entered at checkout, right before you complete the payment for your selected domain.

faq.question: What domain extension should I choose?
faq.answer: This depends on your business and target audience — .com is broadly recognized, while country-specific extensions like .in can suit a local audience.

faq.question: Do I need to verify my email after registering?
faq.answer: Yes, verifying your email is typically required to fully activate a newly registered domain.

faq.question: Is buying a domain through Hostinger different from other registrars?
faq.answer: The general process — searching, selecting an extension, and checking out — is similar across registrars, though pricing and available coupons vary.
